#!/bin/sh
set -eu
export GMP=yes GMP_PREFIX=build/deps/gmp/native
out=tests/out/intinf/m4
run() {
 name=$1; shift
 printf 'START %s\n' "$name"
 if "$@" > "$out/$name.log" 2>&1; then printf 'PASS %s\n' "$name"; else
  code=$?; printf 'FAIL %s exit %s\n' "$name" "$code"; tail -n 30 "$out/$name.log"; exit "$code"
 fi
}
run check make check JOBS=8
run matrix make matrix-quick JOBS=8
cp tests/out/matrix/report.md "$out/host-report.md"
run asan-build make vm-asan JOBS=4
run gmp-asan python3 tests/intinf/backends.py --vm bin/runevm-asan --stress --out tests/out/intinf/m4/asan-backends
run hardening-asan python3 tests/intinf/hardening.py --vm bin/runevm-asan --out tests/out/intinf/m4/asan-hardening
run stack-asan sh tests/run-tests.sh -j 8 --vm bin/runevm-stack-asan
run register-asan make test-register-asan JOBS=8
run native-asan make test-native-asan JOBS=8
run stress make test-stress JOBS=8
run heap make test-heap JOBS=8
run windows make test-windows JOBS=2
run portability make test-portability JOBS=8
limitations: Remote CI has not been run here.
Windows and portability builds remain GMP-free in M4; enabled cross builds and release CPU provisioning remain M5.
Saved list oracle sanitizer stress uses GC interval 101; compact cases use interval 1, following the recorded M3 timeout.
